description: This file defines a mock class for the IApplicationManagementServer interface used in testing within the Rialto server IPC component. It includes mock methods for initializing, sending state change events, starting, and stopping the server.

classes.name: ApplicationManagementServerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IApplicationManagementServer interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Mocks the initialization method which takes a socket descriptor.

methods.name: sendStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Mocks the method to send a session server state change event.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Mocks the method to start the server.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Mocks the method to stop the server.
